messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-4456 fired for service=model-serving-v2 - canary group 'canary-3' failing health checks (5xx spike). Alert threshold crossed at 1746001233. Link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-4456

Dave (oncall): acked on PagerDuty — I'm on it. pulling logs and canary dashboard now.

Ben (SRE): saw the alert too. metrics: 5xx rate jumped from ~0.3% to 9% in the last 2m, p95 latency doubled. looks correlated with deploy id shown in deploy-bot below.

Emma (eng-lead): thanks @Dave. which deploy rolled to canary-3? any traceback?

deploy-bot: Deploy event: id=deploy-20251017-7f3a2c commit=ae3b9f2 on service=model-serving-v2 -> rollout: canary-3 (10% traffic) at 1746001200. Rollout status: failing healthcheck on hosts i-07*, i-09*

Dave (oncall): grabbing recent logs from i-07. seeing repeated exceptions: 
```
2025-10-17T10:00:58Z ERROR inference_engine.py: client OOM while allocating KV cache
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/redwood/inference_engine.py", line 432, in handle_request
    result = model.generate(...)
MemoryError: Unable to allocate
```

Claire (CSM): flagging that a support ticket from AcmeCorp just hit our inbox reporting failed responses for their staging integration. They are on the canary traffic list (we precanned them).

Ben (SRE): looks like memory regressed due to a model change (commit ae3b9f2 changed kv cache prefetch). p95 mem on canary hosts jumped ~1.8GB.

Emma (eng-lead): ok — high customer impact and clear regression with this deploy. Propose immediate pause + rollback of canary. can someone run `redwoodctl rollout pause deploy-20251017-7f3a2c` and then rollback if pause doesn't clear?

Dave (oncall): running pause now.

deploy-bot: `redwoodctl rollout pause deploy-20251017-7f3a2c` -> success. Rollout paused at 10% canary.

Dave (oncall): pause succeeded. healthchecks still showing failing hosts. I recommend rollback.

Ben (SRE): I can run rollback. plan: rollback canary to previous stable image, monitor 5xx for 10m, then continue. rollback command: 
```
redwoodctl rollback --deploy-id deploy-20251017-7f3a2c --target stable-20251017-6b1c9a --force
```

Emma (eng-lead): do it. tag me on the follow-up. notify AcmeCorp ERT.

Claire (CSM): I just DM'd AcmeCorp with a heads-up: we detected regressions on their canary traffic and are rolling back. They'll expect follow-up.

Dave (oncall): executing rollback now.

deploy-bot: Rollback started: rollback-id=rb-20251017-01 triggered by Dave.

Ben (SRE): rollback in progress — replacing canary instances with stable image. watching metrics.

Dave (oncall): links: canary dashboard https://grafana.redwood/services/model-serving-v2/canary-3 | logs https://logs.redwood/streams/i-07* | pd incident https://pd.example/incidents/PD-4456

Ben (SRE): 2m after rollback start: 5xx rate dropping back to baseline, p95 latency improving.

Emma (eng-lead): good. once stable for 10 minutes we'll mark incident mitigated. add a follow-up to investigate kv cache change and add a canary OOM guard.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed successfully at 1746001485. rollback-id=rb-20251017-01.

Dave (oncall): verified: canary hosts healthy, no OOM traces in last 5m. PD incident auto-escalation cancelled.

Claire (CSM): letting AcmeCorp know rollback completed and services look normal. they asked for a postmortem and ETA to re-roll with a fix.

Emma (eng-lead): assigning postmortem owners: Ben (root cause analysis) + Eng-ML to verify model change. Dave to draft incident timeline. Claire to coordinate with the customer and capture impact.

Ben (SRE): initial hypothesis: commit ae3b9f2 increased KV prefetch buffer size; under certain batch/sequence combos it exceeds expected memory headroom. will reproduce locally and open a PR to revert or add defensive caps.

Dave (oncall): final checks done. marking thread resolved for oncall. I'll leave the PD incident open briefly until postmortem doc exists.

Emma (eng-lead): thanks team. next steps: (1) Ben to open RCA and PR, (2) add canary mem guard + alert to prevent auto-escalation, (3) schedule postmortem doc and link. Ping me when PR lands.

Ben (SRE): created issue IN-8977 and PR draft linked in the issue. will post updates in #eng-runtime. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident PD-4456 set to "mitigated" at 1746001510 by user Dave.

Dave (oncall): closing thread from oncall perspective. leaving notes in incident tracker. :white_check_mark:
